title: PHP email queue worker
context: CLI worker that sends queued emails; several copies run in parallel, so each email must be claimed by exactly one worker. attempts counts failed tries and an email is tried at most 5 times. $mailer->send() returns true on success and false on failure (it throws only on configuration errors). bootstrap.php provides $pdo and $mailer.
code: "SELECT id, recipient, subject, body FROM email_queue
WHERE status = 'pending' AND attempts <= 5 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1"
$pdo->prepare("UPDATE email_queue SET status = 'sending', worker = ? WHERE id = ?")
$pdo->prepare("UPDATE email_queue SET status = 'sent', sent_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?")
$pdo->prepare("UPDATE email_queue SET status = 'pending', attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = ?")

expected.why: attempts <= 5 picks emails that already failed 5 times, giving a 6th try; use < 5
the claim does not require status = 'pending' or check rowCount(), so two workers that selected the same row both send it
the false return value is ignored, so failed deliveries are marked sent and never retried
